title: A New Lunar Crater: McGetchin
explanation:
# A Whale-Sized Asteroid Just Rewrote the Moon's Surface

A space rock the size of a humpback whale slammed into the Moon between April and May 2024, blasting out a crater as wide as two soccer fields—an impact so rare that astronomers expect to see one only once every 132 years. NASA's lunar orbiter captured the dramatic before-and-after images, revealing not just the visible crater but a sprawling cold zone around it where the impact's shock wave fluffed up the Moon's dusty surface like freshly fallen snow, proving that these cosmic collisions reshape the lunar landscape far more dramatically than scientists previously realized.
